name: Morph To Survive Tower
desc:
Welcome to the Morph To Survive Tower! 🤩

👍 Like the game and join the group

When the game begins, you will be hider or a seeker. If you are a hider, you morph into objects nearby and hide in the tower. But if you are a seeker, use your rocket launcher to eliminate the hiders.

Invite your friends to get even more fun! 🤗
Play with friends for FREE on our free private servers! 🎮

This game is INSPIRED by Morph Troll Tower & Hide or Die! from Morph Troll Towers & 0 CCU Games.
